'''Ralos' Rise''' is a mountain found west of [[Civitas illa Fortis]] in [[Varlamore]]. At the summit is [[the Teomat]], home to both the Church of [[Ralos]] and the Sect of [[Ranul]]. The mountain is considered a holy site, as it is said that the mountain was where Ralos made his first and only appearance. The summit also houses a step pyramid with an [[exposed altar]], a place where players can bless bones and jugs of wines for [[Prayer]] training at the [[libation bowl]].

At the southern face of the mountain lies the entrance to [[Cam Torum]], the last bastion of the [[Imcando dwarves]]. The city, along with [[Neypotzli]], a prison built by the [[Old Ones]], are accessed as part of the [[Perilous Moons]] quest.

Lastly, the mountain also has an outflow spring that leads to the [[Fortis Aqueduct]], serving as the source of freshwater for [[Civitas illa Fortis]].

==Transportation==
* [[Pendant of Ates]] to Ralos' Rise (With the [[Statue (Ates)|statue of ates]] unlocked at this location.)
* [[Quetzal Transport System]] to the Teomat. The Quetzal Transport System can be accessed in several ways:
** [[Ring of dueling]] to [[Fortis Colosseum]] and run west (this requires [[Glory|Hero status]] in the Colosseum)
** [[Hunter cape]] to [[Hunter Guild]] and run west
** [[Quetzal whistle]]
** [[Civitas illa Fortis Teleport]] and run north-east
** The east gate of [[Varrock]]
* [[Civitas illa Fortis Teleport]] and run west
